summary: Yakama Reservation lookout: a cabin site from 1920, present steel cab on a concrete base built 1976, staffed each season per 2024 pages, closed to the public except tours.

facts.design: Two-story concrete base with a steel cab; the present structure dates from 1976

access.note: Yakama Nation land is closed to the public; visits have come through tours the Yakama Nation arranged.

visit.trail_note: Closed to the public. The Yakama Nation provided a spring and fall guided tour to a small group in 2019, in exchange for volunteer help opening and closing the lookout.

corrections.why: No height appears in the three pages read; TrailChick gives only the lookout type and the register gives no height. The 3.0 m figure in the record has no source.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: A cabin stood on the summit from 1920, and the present steel structure dates from 1976. The two years refer to different structures on the same site.

notes_for_editor: Staffing rests on the 2024 TrailChick page and an undated firelookout.com page; no 2025 or 2026 source was confirmed. The 2019 tours come from TrailChick only. The record's 3.0 m height has no source in the pages read and is proposed for removal. A search summary said some sources describe staffing as only occasional; I did not read that page, so it is not used. Fact-check 2026-10-08: the story's 'several structures' was replaced with firelookout.com's 'over a dozen' count, because the register's wording ('over a different structures') gives no usable number. The TrailChick citation for the one-of-two claim was corrected to TrailChick only, and the 'visits are guided tours' sentence was narrowed to what TrailChick describes.
